date.as_written: jāte nevāravarṣe, śaśinidhimunibhiḥ māghamāse tu kṛṣṇe, paṃcamyāṃ śukavāre ... samvat 791 phālguṇa śukla 6

notes: The chronogram śaśinidhimunibhiḥ (1-9-7 = NS 791) corresponds to the numerical date samvat 791 added at the very end. The verse records completion or progress in Māgha kṛṣṇa 5 (Friday, Hasta nakṣatra), while the postscript specifies Phālguṇa śukla 6.
